strongest_angle: Analyzing the October 2026 International Monetary Fund Global Financial Stability Report warning regarding potential artificial intelligence market corrections, rising bond yields, and cyberattacks.

key_facts.fact: The International Monetary Fund published the Global Financial Stability Report on October 13, 2026, warning that weaker artificial intelligence investment could trigger a market correction.
Authors Athanasios Vamvakidis and Jason Wu detailed on October 12, 2026, that artificial intelligence-driven market corrections are one of three key escalating risks.
The Guardian reported on October 13, 2026, that the International Monetary Fund warned that an artificial intelligence share crash puts world financial stability at risk.
Reuters noted on October 13, 2026, that the International Monetary Fund cautioned against complacency in global financial markets facing artificial intelligence selloffs.
